HOperatorTrace.projected_operator_kernel_trace.{u_2, u_3} {ι : Type u_2} [Fintype ι] {X : Type u_3} [MeasurableSpace X]
  (nu : MeasureTheory.Measure X) (b : X → ℝ) (hb : ∀ (x : X), 0 < b x) (V : ℝ) (hV : 0 < V)
  (E : Submodule ℂ ↥(MeasureTheory.Lp ℂ 2 nu)) [E.HasOrthogonalProjection] (u : ι → ↥(MeasureTheory.Lp ℂ 2 nu))
  (hu : Orthonormal ℂ u) (hspan : Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range u) = E)
  (A : ↥(MeasureTheory.Lp ℂ 2 nu) →L[ℂ] ↥(MeasureTheory.Lp ℂ 2 nu)) :
  ∫ (x : X),
      ∑ i,
        HNormalizedKernel.haarKernel b V (↑↑(u i)) (↑↑((ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint A) (u i))) x
          x ∂ENNReal.ofReal V • nu =
    Masullo.TraceClass.trace (E.starProjection.comp A)

KPhysicalMask.realMaskCLM_strong.{u_1} {X : Type u_1} [MeasurableSpace X] (mu : MeasureTheory.Measure X)
  (rho : ℕ → X → ℝ) (hm : ∀ (n : ℕ), Measurable (rho n)) (hb : ∀ (n : ℕ) (x : X), 0 ≤ rho n x ∧ rho n x ≤ 1)
  (hp : ∀ (x : X), ∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, rho n x = 1) (f : ↥(MeasureTheory.Lp ℂ 2 mu)) :
  Filter.Tendsto (fun n => (KPhysicalMask.realMaskCLM mu (rho n) ⋯ ⋯) f) Filter.atTop (nhds f)

DSourceKernel.finiteKernel_realMask_trace.{u_1} {X : Type u_1} [MeasurableSpace X] (nu : MeasureTheory.Measure X)
  (b : X → ℝ) (hb : ∀ (x : X), 0 < b x) (E : Submodule ℂ ↥(MeasureTheory.Lp ℂ 2 nu)) [FiniteDimensional ℂ ↥E]
  (A : ↥(MeasureTheory.Lp ℂ 2 nu) →L[ℂ] ↥(MeasureTheory.Lp ℂ 2 nu)) (rho : X → ℝ) (hm : Measurable rho)
  (hbound : ∀ (x : X), 0 ≤ rho x ∧ rho x ≤ 1) :
  have M := KPhysicalMask.realMaskCLM nu rho hm hbound;
  MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun x => ↑(rho x) * DSourceKernel.finiteKernel nu b E A x x) nu ∧
    ∫ (x : X), ↑(rho x) * DSourceKernel.finiteKernel nu b E A x x ∂nu =
        ∫ (x : X), DSourceKernel.finiteKernel nu b E (A.comp M) x x ∂nu ∧
      ∫ (x : X), ↑(rho x) * DSourceKernel.finiteKernel nu b E A x x ∂nu =
        Masullo.TraceClass.trace (E.starProjection.comp (A.comp M))
